headline: Octopus proposes shared latent KV state for branching deep-search agents
summary: The Octopus preprint describes a GPU-resident key-value (KV) state directed acyclic graph for branching search, attention-only mounting of sibling branches and a packed DAG-GRPO training method. In experiments with Qwen3.5-4B, the authors report 49.6% on BrowseComp-Plus and 51.2% on OpenResearcher, alongside KV-mount retention and task-hijacking measurements, throughput and peak-memory comparisons. These are paper-reported results from a single-backbone setup, not independently reproduced.
